test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options including disable function signatures and custom docstrings
test_disable_function_signatures: test that pybind11 options disable function signatures on bound C++ functions
test_custom_docstrings: test that custom docstrings are applied to pybind11 bound functions
test_overloaded_docstrings: test docstring behavior on pybind11 overloaded function definitions
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that user defined docstrings are suppressed for non function pybind11 objects
